definition: a machine that turns energy into motion
description: A man in blue overalls works in a workshop on a stripped scooter whose engine block sits exposed in the frame, tightening a part with a screwdriver and grinning at it. The shot cuts to an open car bonnet with the four-cylinder engine, belts, alternator and hoses in plain view. Then he is outside on the grass beside a huge chrome-topped V8 engine mounted on a black steel stand, first pushing it, then standing back with his hands on his head, astonished at the size of it.

en.question: What is the man working on?

es.answer: Está trabajando en el motor de un scooter.
phrases: llevarse las manos a la cabeza
es.question: ¿En qué está trabajando el hombre?

fr.answer: Il travaille sur un moteur de scooter.
fr.question: Sur quoi l'homme travaille-t-il ?
